summary: Physics-buffer teardown routine called from collision and scene loaders (CollisionShapeInit, CollisionContactBufferAllocator, BezierPatchTessellation, CollisionGeometryOperationSelector, SceneTrackFileLoader): saves field 0x8, zeroes fields 0x4 and 0x0, frees the saved field-0x8 buffer through its allocation header (result-4), then conditionally destroys and frees the physics sub-components referenced by fields 0xC and 0x10 before zeroing them. Returns the last free result.

operations.description: Save the current value of field this+0x8 into result before zeroing it.
If the saved field-0x8 value is non-zero, free its buffer via FreeWrapper_7bcf(result-4), where the allocation header precedes the buffer by 4 bytes.
Zero field this+0x8 after freeing the buffer.
If the pointer stored in field this+0xC is non-zero, enter the sub-component teardown branch.
PhysicsSubComponentDestroy(pointer at field this+0xC): destroy the physics sub-component.
FreeWrapper_7bcf(pointer at field this+0xC): free the sub-component buffer.
If the pointer stored in field this+0x10 is non-zero, enter the sub-component teardown branch.
PhysicsSubComponentDestroy(pointer at field this+0x10): destroy the physics sub-component.
FreeWrapper_7bcf(pointer at field this+0x10): free the sub-component buffer.
Return result, the value of the most recent FreeWrapper_7bcf call, or the original saved field-0x8 value when no free ran.

unresolved: Why the field-0x8 buffer is freed through an allocation header (result-4) while the field-0xC and field-0x10 buffers are freed directly.
Class identity of the owning object (fields at 0x0, 0x4, 0x8, 0xC, 0x10), used by several collision and scene loaders.
Whether the sub-component buffers (fields 0xC, 0x10) are separately allocated or owned inside the field-0x8 allocation.
